hypothesis_assessments.finding: Filtering reduces realized losses in these accounts but never produces a positive active result. May activity drops from fifteen trades to five; August has no joint-context opportunity at all. This does not establish an economically useful active skill or a harmful ban for another context.

Longer holding reduces loss in May but increases loss in August's unfiltered account. No universal holding improvement was found; do not choose a future holding rule by the already observed calendar month.

resource_facts.measurement: Observed elapsed time, not CPU hours, tokens, cost savings or profitable knowledge per hour.

clock_account_boundary: Each original loaded 1556 rows with 200 actual warmup and 1356 decisions. All mature closes occur on their entry UTC date; all final open-position counts are zero. Observed six-row holds stay within 30 minutes and twenty-four-row holds within 120 minutes. This is not a general session-flat guarantee, marked-equity drawdown, independently observed tick fill or broker demo proof.
exposure_boundary: May/August precede the October/December examples that motivated this hypothesis. This is retrospective cross-month discovery in reused history, not chronological forward validation, untouched data or a combined independent-trade sample. Do not sum separately initialized account results into a portfolio return.
